baseline.relation: self-consistency of the reviewed local no-fit build of these exact inputs and recipe (no baseline run, no comparison)

fixed.calibration: none (identity): no B2 or provider fits by design; the backbone quartet is projected (bounded, decreasing) and decoded with inclusive q_k >= 0.20

gpp_availability.rule: a source month is available iff the earliest release covering it is dated on or before the simulated run date; none before 2019-12-01; filtered before every derived GPP feature

model_card.architecture: Four independent XGBRegressor (reg:squarederror, CPU hist, seed 42, 16 threads, no early stopping); q3 and the shared q2/q4/q5 group each take n_estimators, learning_rate, max_depth, min_child_weight, subsample and colsample_bytree from the frozen winner of this horizon (values in the settings section as q3_* and other_*; search space n_estimators 100-600, learning_rate 0.02-0.20 log, max_depth 4-12, min_child_weight 0-32, subsample 0.5-1, colsample_bytree 0.4-1); reg_alpha 0, reg_lambda 1, gamma 0.1 (q3) / 0 (q2/q4/q5); unnormalized 24-month half-life weights per monthly row; no calibration by design (identity units, no core inputs); bounded decreasing projection; inclusive q_k >= 0.20 phase decoding.
model_card.evaluation: Holdout 2026-01..10 metrics are reported only; no performance acceptance gate (prd.md R12).
model_card.family_title: Validity-augmented pooled final stage (GOSIF v3 + CH validity, oracle-free)
model_card.feature_engineering: CH validity correction (task 10-28, ch_links.csv.gz sha256 ac4ad6aaa8dc...): Eligible Cadre Harmonise raw labels are linked through their documented source route (legacy gdf_ch features with may25 current records; the dec25 2025 centroid join; the mars26 refresh lineage) to a current reference window; linked rows of the same source and destination country fill blank existing area-months of that window with copies (all new rows are copies; occupied and QC-invalid rows keep their values); the 150 May-2026 upstream copies become copies of their January report with one January history event per area (storage month May retained); cross-country, CAF, ambiguous and unresolved labels are preserved without expansion, and cross-country labels and events also carry their source-report family for exclusions. Copies take the reference-window start month as their nominal source and availability month. GPP_mean/GPP_std of the interim are replaced (task 10-27, corrected interim sha256 b2d5d2ce6bd6...; extraction sha256 11aa7f744c68...): zonal means of the official GOSIF-GPP v3 monthly Mean and SD rasters 2010-01..2025-12 over all 6,227 panel polygons, fill codes 65534/65535 masked before averaging, scale 0.01 (g C m-2 month-1), independent ArcGIS 10.8 cell-centre memberships on the source grid; a polygon-month without valid cells is NaN; 2026 GPP is blank (no source); no old-series value is retained. The 13 GPP_mean-derived columns (value, MA3/MA6/MA12, SD12, same-month z and its MA3/MA6/MA12, vegetation-stress share12/months_since/longest_run12/any12) are recomputed from it; GPP_std is not a model input. 527 inputs in this order: the frozen compact296 block without its 14 conflict columns (282, incl. the two national IDP columns), 128 AlphaEarth 2017 admin descriptors, the 114 aggregated-ACLED columns, then the three local-IDP columns idp_ipcch_ffill6_current, idp_ipcch_ffill6_ma3, idp_ipcch_ffill6_ma6 (x(O), mean x(O-2..O), mean x(O-5..O) of idp_ffill6, idp_ipcch_monthly.parquet sha256 8b2ba2998817...). The 14 compact296 conflict columns (event_count_violence and sum_fatalities_violence value/MA3/MA6/MA12/SD12 at O and the event nonzero-stress share12/months_since/longest_run12/any12) are removed; the raw old ACLED panel columns stay in the interim as provenance only. They are replaced by 114 columns of the 18 staged aggregated ACLED series acled_agg_{events,fatalities,exposure,exposure_share,spill_events,spill_fatalities}_{battles,erv,vac} of IPCCH_202610_interim_acledagg_gosifv3_20261027.csv (sha256 b2d5d2ce6bd6...; monthly aggregate sha256 539746f5f6bc...): for every series x(A), trailing means over A-2..A, A-5..A and A-11..A (at least 2/3/6 observed months) and the sample SD over A-11..A (ddof 1, at least 6 observed) (90 columns, names s__{value,ma3,ma6,ma12,sd12}_at_origin_lag1); for the six event series the persistence of the NaN-preserving signal x > 0: share12, longest_run12 and any12 over A-11..A (at least 6 observed months; a missing month breaks a run) and months_since (calendar months since the latest observed event, NaN before the first, advancing through missing months) (24 columns, s__nonzero_stress__{share12,months_since,longest_run12,any12}_at_origin_lag1). Every one of the 114 columns is evaluated at A = O - 1 = T - H - 1 for fitting rows, original scoring rows and validity copies (at their own recipient month); no ACLED value of month O or later enters a row. Missing ACLED values stay NaN (never zero). Every non-ACLED column keeps the production run's name, relative order and timing (built at O = T - H; history from original reported phases with the scoring context's report families removed, H0 bound T-1, else O); values equal the production run except the 13 GPP_mean-derived columns (GOSIF-v3 input) and the five reported-phase history columns, which are rebuilt from the CH-corrected report events and families. Inputs otherwise equal the 2026-10-19 refresh (WFP_Price and WFP_Price_std redefined as 100 + local-currency year-on-year %; WFP_Price__price_shock_stress keeps its yoy > 10% rule on that index; new World Bank RTP and Bloomberg vintages; IPC areas/analyses snapshot 2026-10-19). All transforms are recomputed in the job.
model_card.limitations: Hyperparameters were selected at H12, not re-tuned at H14; CH reference windows and data vintages are retrospective; GPP availability simulated from the provider update log; year dummies end at 2026 (2027+ targets all-zero in operation).
model_card.model_type: XGBoost regressor quartet (no calibration), frozen parameters mapped from the tuned H0/H6/H12 winners
model_card.role: Operational final-stage H14 candidate (task 10-29): one 2026-01..10 context, mapped frozen H12 parameters
model_card.scope: global pooled (all 53 original IPCCH countries), one final-stage context
model_card.summary: Final-stage H14 fit (targets 2026-01..2026-10, label cutoff 2024-11) with the 12 quartet parameters frozen for H12 (no new search, no refit, no historical contexts).
model_card.target: cumulative phase shares q2-q5, q_k = sum(P_k..P5) / sum(P1..P5) from raw phase shares; QC: P1-P4 observed, a truly missing P5 = 0, every share finite in [0,1], exact total in [0.90,1.10], estimated_population ignored; phase = greatest k with q_k >= 0.20 (else 1); crisis = phase >= 3; training and evaluation rows include IPC validity copies (inherited: an existing IPC label copied to blank months of its analysis validity period) and Cadre Harmonise validity copies (new in this refit: an eligible current CH label copied to blank area-months of its reference window, source and destination in the same country), each counted once

training_window: one final-stage context at cutoff 2026-01 - H; every eligible label up to the cutoff; weights halve every 24 months
